facts.fact: Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video Marketing report, cited by AdWave, found that 89% of people say watching a video has convinced them to buy a product or service.
facts.quote: According to Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video Marketing report, 89% of people say watching a video has convinced them to buy a product or service

facts.fact: AdWave states that an explainer video is usually 30 to 90 seconds long.
facts.quote: Usually 30 to 90 seconds, it takes a product, service, feature, or concept and answers one question fast

facts.fact: AdWave advises that viewers should recognize their own problem within the first 10 seconds of an explainer video, or they will scroll away.
facts.quote: If people don't recognize their own problem in the first 10 seconds, they scroll away.

facts.fact: AdWave's beat sheet allots 15-20% of explainer runtime to the Problem beat.
facts.quote: | Problem | Make them feel seen | 15-20% |

facts.fact: AdWave's beat sheet allots 20-25% of explainer runtime to the Solution beat.
facts.quote: | Solution | Name the fix | 20-25% |

facts.fact: AdWave's beat sheet allots 40-50% of explainer runtime to the How it works beat.
facts.quote: | How it works | Build belief | 40-50% |

facts.fact: AdWave's beat sheet allots 10-15% of explainer runtime to the Call to action beat.
facts.quote: | Call to action | Drive the next step | 10-15% |

facts.fact: AdWave states that a comfortable narration pace is about 150 words per minute.
facts.quote: A comfortable narration pace is about 150 words per minute.

facts.fact: AdWave states that a 30-second explainer script is closer to 75 words.
facts.quote: A 30-second explainer is closer to 75.

facts.fact: AdWave says the How it works section should have two or three steps at most.
facts.quote: Two or three steps, tops.

facts.fact: AdWave states that a video running past two minutes is no longer an explainer but a demo or tutorial.
facts.quote: Anything past two minutes and you're no longer making an explainer, you're making a demo or a tutorial.

facts.fact: AdWave lists the typical length of a product explainer as 30-60 seconds.
facts.quote: Product explainer | What your product does and the problem it solves | Homepage, landing pages, ads | 30-60 seconds

facts.fact: AdWave lists the typical length of a concept explainer as 60-90 seconds.
facts.quote: Concept explainer | An idea, category, or "what is X" topic | Blog posts, education pages, social | 60-90 seconds

facts.fact: AdWave lists the typical length of a how-it-works explainer as 45-75 seconds.
facts.quote: How-it-works explainer | Your process, steps, or mechanism | Service pages, sales decks, pitches | 45-75 seconds

facts.fact: AdWave lists the typical length of an onboarding explainer as 30-60 seconds.
facts.quote: Onboarding explainer | How to get started or set something up | Welcome emails, in-app, help center | 30-60 seconds

facts.fact: AdWave lists the typical length of a feature explainer as 20-45 seconds.
facts.quote: Feature explainer | A single new feature or update | Release notes, changelogs, social | 20-45 seconds

facts.fact: AdWave claims that its Wavemaker tool produces a finished explainer video in a few minutes, with no editing timeline required.
facts.quote: you get a finished explainer video in a few minutes, no editing timeline required

facts.fact: Wavemaker's storyboard step uses one of its 21 presets.
facts.quote: Wavemaker turns the script into an AI storyboard using one of its 21 presets.

facts.fact: Wavemaker videos typically come back in about two to five minutes, according to the page.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in about two to five minutes.

facts.fact: Through Adwave, a Wavemaker-made explainer video can be distributed on 100+ streaming TV networks starting at $50.
facts.quote: Through Adwave, the same video goes out on 100+ networks from $50, alongside Google, YouTube, Meta, and Reddit.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan exports at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: On quality, the free plan exports at 480p with a watermark, which is useful for testing an idea.

facts.fact: Paid Wavemaker plans remove the watermark and export up to 4K resolution.
facts.quote: Paid plans remove the watermark and go up to 4K, so your homepage explainer looks as sharp as everything else on the page.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits.
facts.quote: Wavemaker's free plan gives you 75 credits, which is enough to create your first video, exporting at 480p with a watermark.

facts.fact: According to the page, an explainer video is typically 30 to 90 seconds long.
facts.quote: An explainer is short (30 to 90 seconds) and answers "what is this and why should I care."

facts.fact: The page advises that a script should aim for roughly 150 words per minute of runtime.
facts.quote: Aim for roughly 150 words per minute of runtime, lead with benefits over features, and end with one clear ask.

facts.fact: Wavemaker exports in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 aspect ratios.
facts.quote: Wavemaker exports in the aspect ratios you'll use: 16:9 for your website and YouTube, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, plus 1:1 and 4:5 for feed posts.

facts.fact: The page says an explainer video should not run past 90 seconds.
facts.quote: If your explainer runs past 90 seconds, you're probably explaining too much.

facts.fact: Each Wavemaker chat refine costs a small number of credits, per the page.
facts.quote: Each refine costs a small number of credits and takes a couple of minutes
